Then read response.read() decode utf-8, json.loads.

Handle HTTPError: if code 429, 5xx -> TransientError. else propagate. Also URLError -> TransientError.

Return dict.

We need to fetch pages sequentially, starting cursor None. Use fetch_page(cursor) function passed. But fetch_page is passed as fetch_page(cursor) returns page dict. In tests, they pass fetch = Mock(side_effect=...). So we call fetch_page(cursor). We need to validate page: must be dict with keys 'items' list and 'next_cursor' null or nonempty string. That will raise ValueError if invalid. So we can use that.

Also id and name nonempty string: check isinstance(str) and len>0.

Also next_cursor: None or nonempty string. If empty string raise ValueError.

Also detect repeated cursor: maintain set of seen cursors. If next_cursor already seen raise ValueError.

Also if page invalid raise ValueError.
